title: Route validation compared archived records with the current reviewer table, so a later table change would fail them
resolution: The reviewer table is kept per rule version; rule and shadow plans are checked against the table of the record's own version, an unknown version is reported, and the design says a table change bumps RULE_VERSION

title: Decision 2, the planned protocol edit, and task 2.3 still placed the route after make verify
resolution: Decision 2 is marked as amended by decision 9, and the planned edit and task 2.3 now route before the recorded make verify

title: The route command requirement said an archived change exits 1, although archive and dated names are usage errors that exit 2
resolution: The requirement now gives exit 1 for an unknown change and exit 2 for archive or a name not shaped as a change name, with a scenario; the design's failure table agrees

title: The git adapter passed the router credential variable to every git child process
resolution: The git child environment drops the credential variable as well as the GIT variables, and a test asserts it

title: The recorded coverage of the evaluation module differed under another Node.js patch version, which the record did not name
resolution: Coverage was measured again under the pinned Node.js 24.22.1 and under 24.22.0, and the record names the version of each figure

title: The network failure test reused a closed port that another process could bind in between
resolution: The test keeps its own server bound and resets every connection, so the failure no longer depends on an unbound port

title: The invocation effort was undefined for a change without route.json
resolution: The protocol says a change without route.json uses the configured effort of governance Authorized reviewers

title: Routed effort changed governance without a policy version entry
resolution: Governance is policy version 7 with a history entry for routed effort, credited to the owner's request and this coordinator-assigned change

title: The evaluation summary claimed the revision that pass 1 reviewed, although fixes before the first pass 1 commit are included
resolution: The printed summary and the design name the revision of the branch's first pass 1 commit, and the design counts the affected changes from the archived records

title: The security heuristic missed this change's credential adapter without a recorded risk
resolution: Design Risks records the miss as a known case and as input to rule version 2

title: The archive evaluation requirement claimed features from before review, while the code takes the parent of the first commit naming pass 1
resolution: The requirement now names the parent of the first branch commit naming pass 1, says fixes before it are included, and keeps the approximate merged diff

title: The coverage record blamed the Node.js patch version for figures that vary between runs of one version
resolution: The patch-version explanation is gone; five new runs record the branch coverage ranges, all above 75%

title: Two evaluation comments and the evaluation schema still named the revision that pass 1 reviewed
resolution: The comments and the schema description name the revision of the branch's first pass 1 commit and say fixes before it are included

title: The archive evaluation kept sending requests after the shadow router answered 401, 402, or 403
resolution: Such a failure now stops the evaluation with exit 1 before further requests and writes nothing; other failures are still recorded per change

title: The route record was deleted and regenerated after review fixes, which worker step 4 does not ask for
resolution: The pre-review route record is restored, and the records of both re-routes say they were not what step 4 asks

title: The route record reads missing credential although the shadow was withheld on purpose
resolution: The record next to the restored route explains the withheld shadow: the route ran without the variable before the in-session confirmation for a live call

title: The invocation effort placeholder was defined both as the routed and as the configured effort
resolution: The placeholder is now the authorized effort: the configured one, replaced by the routed one only once governance authorizes it

title: Jev tests counted requests at the server after a short client timeout and relied on the default 2 s timeout
resolution: Attempts are counted by a wrapper around the real fetch, and the answered and reset tests pass a 30 s timeout

title: The contracts row of the rule table still justified the trigger by one archived case
resolution: The row gives the measured figures, 9 of 18 and 12 elevated by the trigger alone with 4 third passes, citing decision 8

title: The reviewer invocations did not remove the router credential, which a login shell restores
resolution: Every invocation removes the variable, and the protocol says reviewers must not read it or the shell profile and that a login shell restores it

title: Route validation did not check that the recorded triggers are those the features fire
resolution: Thresholds are kept per rule version next to the reviewer tables, and validation reports triggers that the record's version would not fire
